license_evidence.scope: Mistral Large 3 weights as declared on the official model card and GA docs page, pointing at the standard Apache-2.0 text

access_boundary: This record represents the December 2025 Mistral Large 3 release at Hugging Face commit 383ffea2c7d60dfd44ca960e8e691709d4fdb9cd (last modified 2026-07-15), covering the FP8, NVFP4, and BF16 checkpoints, together with the mistral-large-2512 API model and its Azure and Bedrock hosting. Earlier Large generations, the base weights, and community quantizations remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Ungated 675B MoE checkpoints in three precisions under a declared Apache-2.0 grant
GA developer API plus documented Azure and Bedrock hosting with a 256K context window
tradeoffs: No LICENSE file ships beside the weights; the grant rests on card and docs declarations
675B total parameters need single-node 8-GPU-class serving even in FP8
